page: Google Cloud Platform t2a-standard-8 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the t2a server family. It is powered by an Ampere Altra ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor with 8 physical cores and 8 dedicated vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 32.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. The processor features a 32 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 64 KB L1d cache. It supports hardware-accelerated AES cryptography, though it lacks x86-specific instruction sets such as AVX, AVX-512, and AMX. This instance does not include local NVMe storage or bundled GPUs.

Benchmark data indicates that the t2a-standard-8 delivers average performance across most multi-threaded and memory-bound workloads. In stress-ng tests, it achieved a single-core score of 1812.89 and a multi-core score of 14472.4. Memory bandwidth is measured at 563.91 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, dropping to 87.42 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 47.24 GB/sec for large-block writes. Single-threaded performance is a relative bottleneck, with Geekbench single-core (1073.0) and bzip3 single-threaded decompression (8.58 GB/sec) falling into the bottom 25% of tested servers. Similarly, LLM inference tasks using a small 135M model show weak prompt processing (318.52 tokens/sec) and poor text generation (32.29 tokens/sec).

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the t2a-standard-8 offers a dedicated ARM-based architecture that provides predictable physical core allocation without hyperthreading. This design avoids resource contention, making it a stable option for scale-out workloads that benefit from consistent multi-core execution. It achieves average throughput in static web serving (10.09 GB/sec) and software compilation (9005.0 in Geekbench clang tests). The instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded application servers, static web serving, and software compilation pipelines, while being less optimal for single-threaded tasks, cryptographic operations, or machine learning inference.
description: Google Cloud Platform t2a-standard-8 is an ARM-based general-purpose server powered by an Ampere Altra ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores (8 vCPUs) running at 3.0 GHz, paired with 32.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The instance lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Performance benchmarks show average multi-core capabilities, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 6000.0 and a static web serving throughput of 10.09 GB/sec. However, single-threaded performance is weak, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 1073.0 and poor LLM text generation speeds. Lacking AVX and AMX extensions, it relies on dedicated core execution for predictable performance. It is suited for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, and software compilation, offering a balanced resource profile for ARM-native deployments.
